use_case_summary: Primary: in-product support assistant that routes to KB and generates concise answers. Secondary: semantic doc-search for support agents and automated summarization of support tickets. Must support business-hours spikes (Mon-Fri 9-18) and provide deterministic latency for SLA-bound enterprise customers.
capacity_estimates: Observed during Hosted POC: steady-state ~8 QPS, peak bursts to ~35 QPS (ten minute spikes)
Projected production: baseline 12 QPS avg, peak 60 QPS (business-hours), concurrency target 120 active sessions

Token mix (projected): 70% conversational chat (avg prompt 300 tokens, avg completion 180 tokens), 20% embeddings/rerank calls (short payloads, embedding dims 1536), 10% heavy summarization (avg prompt 1,200 tokens, completion 400 tokens)
Estimated token throughput: ~45M prompt tokens/month + ~25M completion tokens/month under current forecast
Latency SLO: 1st token <150ms for short replies; end-to-end <800ms for standard multi-sentence responses
poc_results: Quality: high relevance from curated embedding index; reranking improved first-touch resolution by ~12% in trial data
Performance: hosted trial 95th p50 latency 140ms for short responses, p95 ~420ms during bursts
Cost: Hosted API extrapolation: ~$1,250/mo per 1M prompt+completion token pair (mixed sizes) — finance wants Dedicated ROI
Stability: no API-level errors during trial; saw occasional throttling at sustained bursts >40 QPS (managed via client-side retries)
dedicated_sizing_recommendation: Initial recommendation: Dedicated cluster equivalent to 4x GPU nodes (A100/80GB class) with burst pool of 1 node
Rationale: supports target peak QPS 60 with concurrency headroom for 120 sessions and token-mix above; allows KV/prefix caching for frequent prompts
Autoscaling policy suggestion: maintain baseline 3 nodes, scale to 5 nodes at sustained >30 QPS for 5+ minutes
Expected cost delta vs Hosted: ~+45% predictable fixed per-month vs variable Hosted spend; finance-friendly for ARR >= $75k
